test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-3) Official Paper (Held On: 17 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Who among the following was Governor of both Andhra Pradesh and Telangana in June 2019?
solution:
The correct answer is__** ESL Narasimhan. **__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Ekkadu Srinivasan **Lakshmi Narasimhan( born 1945)** is an Indian former civil daily and politician who served as the first Governor of Telangana. He assumed office as the Governor of Andhra Pradesh in December 2009 and Governor of **Telangana on 2 June 2014. **
 
• **S.L. Narasimhan** is the longest-serving governor. Jishnu Dev Varma is the current serving governor of Telangana. 
 
• A covert Indian Police Service officer, he before served as the Director of the Intelligence Bureau from February 2005 to December 2006. He also served as the **Governor of Chhattisgarh from 2007 to 2009.** Narasimhan served as Governor for **12 years **making him the longest-serving Governor in India. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ​Andhra Pradesh Telugu is a state in the southeastern coastal region of India.
 
• Andhra Pradesh was once a major Buddhist pilgrimage site in the country and a Buddhist learning centre.
 
• A person to be eligible for appointment as Governor should be a citizen of India and have completed age** of 35 years (Article 157). **
 
• The **governors** of the states of India have similar powers and functions at the state level as those of the president of india at the central level.
 
• The governor acts as the nominal head whereas the real power lies with the chief ministers of the states
